name: Niamh Connellan
title: Counsellor (Australian Counselling Association)
description: Niamh P. Connellan prioritises people who have experienced marginalisation, particularly fat, LGBTQIA+, and racialised people; plural people and systems (sometimes referred to as DID or OSDD by medicalised systems); diverse relationship structures including polyamory/non-monogamy, kink and D/s dynamics; ADHD and Autism; and childhood trauma. The people Niamh supports include queer and trans folk, individuals and relationships that engage with kink, BDSM, and D/s dynamics, sex workers, furries, plural people, and neurodiverse people. Sessions 16+, solo and relationship therapy, face-to-face in Preston or telehealth.
specialties: plural people and systems, DID, OSDD, LGBTQIA+, trans, kink, BDSM, D/s, polyamory, childhood trauma, ADHD, autism, sex workers, relationship therapy
identity: Non-Binary, Queer, Fat, Neurodiverse, Mental Ill Health, Polyamorous, and Kinky

name: Emma Fallon
title: Counsellor/Social Worker (AASW)
description: Experience working with LGBTQIA+ people and those wanting to explore their gender and sexuality, ADHD and Autism, people who hear voices, youth mental health, and suicidality and self-injury. If you are queer and/or trans, neurodivergent, disabled, racialized, or engage in kink/BDSM/D/s community or relationships I would love to support you in therapy. Passionate about working with people to overcome day-to-day challenges and past trauma. Face-to-face (Preston) or telehealth, ages 16+.
specialties: LGBTQIA+, trans, gender, sexuality, kink, BDSM, D/s, neurodivergence, ADHD, autism, hearing voices, trauma, Auslan/text-based sessions
identity: Queer, Ace Spectrum, Neurodivergent (AuDHD), Hard of Hearing; 'neurodivergent, genderqueer, and ace-spectrum'

name: Jayson Rom
title: Psychologist
description: Jayson is a psychologist who offers treatment in a safe, confidential, and non-judgmental space for individuals within the lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer, and/or intersex (LGBTQIA+) community, with over 17 years in the field of LGBTQIA+ mental health and sexual health. He is well-versed in supporting diverse relationship structures, including those within the kink and fetish communities. He provides a space to address concerns such as complex trauma, coming out, identity, drug and alcohol use, and relationship issues including navigating monogamy and non-monogamy. Individual and couples therapy in person and online.
specialties: LGBTQIA+, gay, transgender, sexual health, kink, fetish, complex trauma, non-monogamy, addiction, anxiety, depression, psychosis, forensic, clinical supervision
